# Blue regions

# Purple/white bars

    for i in range(5):  # Try up to 5 clicks
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
        if not pink:
            print(f"  No more pink blocks after {i} clicks")
            break
        
        p = pink[0]
        rows = [pt[0] for pt in p['boundary']]
        cols = [pt[1] for pt in p['boundary']]

        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
        white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
        pink_count = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P'])
        print(f"  Click {i+1}: purple={purple[0]['pixels'] if purple else 0}, white={white[0]['pixels'] if white else 0}, pink={pink_count}")
        
        if result.get('level_completed'):
            print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
            break
        if result.get('done'):
            print("GAME DONE!")
            break

</function>
